purpose: Minimal future checked new-local-file admission over the existing BookStore writer; no parallel shelf or UMD importer.
confirmedGaps: saveReadingBook -> saveMetaImmediately -> persist is void; encode/write/external-change failures are logged or skipped and cannot attest success.
queuedWritesLanded is a barrier, not a success result.
validatedRestorePausesWrites is per instance and only checked by some writers; it is not an import lease and does not freeze records.
replaceRecords is the record mutation funnel and bumps mutationRevision; records subscript/append setters route through it.

Existing direct paths commitTXTBookmarks, persistEncodedReadingRecords, loadMeta migrations/reload and baseline-note callbacks need explicit lease analysis. A per-instance pause alone does not protect another BookStore on the same files.
minimalModelChanges: Replace the private boolean pause with a private owned token kind (validated restore or checked import), UUID and generation. Preserve existing restore outward API; require exact owner on finish/apply.
Keep ReadingBook and on-disk JSON schema unchanged for UMD: original UUID.umd is contentFilename, explicit .txt rendering kind. No synthesized TXT index/journal or persisted location at import.
Lease snapshot contains shelf URL, before revision, prior persisted baseline, persist sequence fence, candidate UUID/file URL and owned recovery directory; no file paths from incoming metadata.

For multiple stores writing the same metadata URLs, either generalize an existing shared writer admission gate keyed by canonical shelf URL, or prove/ enforce single writable owner. Do not silently rely on only the app singleton. This is an unresolved implementation requirement, not a completed primitive.
pauseAndDrain: Begin on MainActor: reject unreadable/blocked metadata, active restore/import token, candidate UUID/path collision. Flush already requested legacy work using existing API, then acquire pause synchronously before yielding; fence late prior writer bookkeeping.

Await the already existing queuedWritesLanded once; do not add any DispatchQueue/.async/.sync/GCD calls. Because queue entries admitted before pause have completed and later entries defer, detached checked I/O may run without overlap only if every relevant writer honors the same owner token.
After drain, copy owned baseline/snapshot values into Task.detached. No background access to live records, @Published data or the store; no blocking MainActor wait.

Extract a small checked throws shelf-file operation from existing I/O so legacy call sites retain catch/log behavior and checked admission receives the actual error. Do not retrofit every legacy caller into success semantics in this batch.
recordsWhilePaused: Do not overwrite or freeze the UI library behind an old snapshot. Permit normal record mutations through replaceRecords; increment mutationRevision and mark work deferred as today.

Check token ownership and mutationRevision after encoding, before install, and immediately after detached install. Any intervening mutation is an explicit conflict, never an automatic retry or stale replacement.

Synchronous legacy commits must reject the checked lease before any disk access, preserving current memory state. Void legacy saves keep deferred intent, not a false persisted marker. load/reload/migration/restore and same-file other-instance writers must be excluded or conflict-failed explicitly.

On successful final admission, only insert the new record into the current records under exact revision/token ownership; never replace all current records with captured output. Update persisted baseline for precisely the snapshot written.
beforeAfterAndRollback: Use an owned recovery directory containing exact prior shelf bytes (or explicit absent-file marker), candidate encoded bytes/digests and original UMD snapshot identity. Write recovery before touching the shelf.
Before atomic install, compare the actual old shelf bytes/existence to the baseline captured after drain. Reject external-change conflict without touching the shelf. No stale baseline overwrite.

After install, a failed main-actor revision/token check requires compare-before-rollback: restore old bytes only while the current shelf is still precisely this attempt's installed bytes. Never clobber a later external restore.

If rollback succeeds, publish no candidate, retain in-memory edits and release lease then enqueue existing deferred current-state writer. If rollback or compare fails, preserve owned recovery and original UMD candidate; keep writes blocked until explicit recovery resolution, report conflict/recovery failure, publish no candidate. Never delete recovery on uncertainty.

Portable tests cannot establish atomic CAS against uncoordinated external processes: byte comparison plus atomic replacement is a cooperative in-process boundary, with a remaining external TOCTOU risk. Must not claim a cross-process filesystem transaction or power-loss/crash atomicity.
cancellation: Before any shelf install, propagate cancellation to owned read/decode/prepare tasks; join cleanup; remove only paths allocated by the current attempt.

Once shelf install may have occurred, finish success-or-compensation under the lease even if the caller cancels. Do not abandon a detached write/result or release the lease early. After successful durability/publication define whether caller cancellation is returned; it must not misreport a committed book as absent.
Cancellation during compensation never permits deleting owned recovery or returning while the shelf outcome is unknown.
routingRequiredBeforeRegistration: BookParserRegistry and LocalBookImportService gain UMD only after checked commit and explicit reader routing; .umd remains unsupported to the current product in this preparation.

ReaderView+PageBuilding must branch .umd before TXTFileReader and TXT index migration. Build TXTBookDocument(chapterIndexes:text:) and TXTLazyAttributedStringBuilder from the validated UMD directory; source offsets / 2 are UTF16 boundaries after 2029->LF, no title regex.

TXTLazyAttributedStringBuilder defaults to Aozora markup interpretation. UMD plain text must explicitly disable parsesAozoraMarkup so literal ruby-like marks are not reinterpreted. Rendered offsets remain relative to their actual spine chapter; no raw file byte offset is a persisted charOffset.

WorkTableOfContents.chapters local .txt branch currently invokes TXTReaderPreparationService and indexForListing; add the same UMD explicit-directory route before it, no synthetic TXT cache or journal.

BookStore.content(for:), TXTBookDocument(book:store:), TXTContentProviderAdapter and makeLocalTXTProvider are synchronous TXT assumptions. Route callers to async validated UMD preparation or explicitly reject .umd; never decode compressed bytes as text or silently provide an empty fallback.
ReadingBook.displayFormatLabel needs the UMD file format label while retaining the .txt renderer capabilities.

shareableFileURL direct local-file path, Calibre returnBookFile and iCloud local content filename use contentFilename and can preserve original .umd, subject to actual execution. WebDAV backs up sources/books/rules JSON only today and does not claim TXT/EPUB/UMD payload backup.

Import file presentation, Calibre accepted-format negotiation, remote library/Works file filters, direct-export/backup and Info.plist document types require a final targeted source audit before exposing UMD selection; no extension-only support claim.
plannedMeaningfulTests: held original writer + admitted drain proves no overlapping checked file I/O; unrelated in-memory edit forces conflict without dropping the edit
before-install external shelf change forces conflict; successful install publishes only after real checked write
after-install revision change compensates only exact own bytes; external change prevents rollback and retains recovery
write/encode/rollback faults preserve old shelf/owned recovery with no candidate publication
cancel before install cleans owned staging; cancel after install joins compensation/result
same shelf in two stores, restore/index bookmark/sync/reload direct writers cannot bypass lease

5 original Java fixtures through actual LocalBookImportService -> persisted original bytes -> same reader/TOC -> reopen exact chapter bodies/relative locations; failed import leaves existing shelf unchanged
limits: Design is not executed or implemented; no Swift SDK/iOS/device validation.
No new queue/GCD/sleep/retry, no parallel storage, no full UMD/MOBI/DRM/cover support.
This cooperative checked import must not be advertised as fixing all legacy void persistence or as a global crash/power-loss transaction.
The multi-writer admission gate and post-install conflict compensation require their own small reviewed implementation batch; current parser is intentionally unregistered.
